notes: Eighty terms, the largest page in the course, so it becomes two areas: mammals, and then
'calf' also appears in Arms, Legs and Inside the Body as the muscle. Different areas.
crocodile/alligator (cocodrilo/caimán) is a real pair but they sit in different areas here:
the crocodile with the wild mammals as the page has it, the alligator with the sea animals.

units.name: Pets and farm animals
units.topic: The animals people keep. A mare is a female horse, a bull is a male cow

units.name: Young animals and livestock
units.topic: The young of farm animals and the larger animals kept or hunted elsewhere. A calf is a young cow, a lamb a young sheep

units.name: Big cats and bears
units.topic: The large predators and the primates beside them

units.name: African animals
units.topic: The very large animals of the savannah and the forest

units.name: Forest animals
units.topic: Smaller wild animals, the ones you might see near a town or in a river
